title: Integrated bionic LiDAR for adaptive 4D machine vision
core_idea: Introduce a retina-inspired, chip-scale LiDAR architecture that implements dynamic gazing by combining an agile external-cavity laser with reconfigurable electro-optic frequency combs to create coherent, parallel and reconfigurable sensing channels that allocate sensing resources to critical regions without global oversampling.
tldr: Proposes a hardware-efficient, retina-inspired photonic LiDAR that adaptively focuses sensing resources via reconfigurable frequency-comb channels to enable efficient, high-resolution 4D machine vision and cooperative imaging with cameras.
